notablePrerequisites:
Barrenton Medic has a vigilance counter on it.
Barrenton Medic has no -1/-1 counters.
description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat until Barrenton Medic has four counters on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three -1/-1 counters from Barrenton Medic, causing you to mill three cards and return any permanent with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
